data.current_owner: ಹೆಚ್ ಸಿ ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ ಬಿನ್ ಲೇ ಚನ್ನೇಗೌಡ
data.raw_notes: Mutation entry MR No. H6, year 2012-2013, type ಖಾತೆ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ (Account change), acquisition ಪೌತಿ (inheritance/partition). Affects survey numbers 117/3, 117/5, 118/1, 119, 120. Previous owners include ಹುಚ್ಚೇಗೌಡ, ಕೆಂಪೇಗೌಡ, ದೇವೇಗೌಡ, ಚನ್ನೇಗೌಡ. Current owners (sons - ಮಗ relation) include ಹೆಚ್ ಸಿ ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ, ಹೆಚ್ ಸಿ ಲಿಂಗೇಗೌಡ, ಅಪ್ಪಾಜಿಗೌಡ, ರಾಮಕೃಷ್ಣ, ನಿಂಗೇಗೌಡ, ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ, ರಾಮೇಗೌಡ, ಕೆಂಚೇಗೌಡ, and ನಂಜಮ್ಮ (ಇತರೆ - other relation, likely wife). Tahsildar approval date 04/12/2012. Village: ಹರಿಹರ, Hobli: ಸಾತನೂರು, Taluk: ಕನಕಪುರ, District: ರಾಮನಗರ.

reasons: No critical issues found in MR

major_risks: Only one mutation entry (H6, 2012-2013) visible — no subsequent mutations recorded for over a decade, which may indicate incomplete RTC/MR extract
Multiple legal heirs (sons and wife) involved in inheritance (ಪೌತಿ); consent/release deeds from all co-parceners required to establish exclusive title
Property is jointly held across survey numbers 117/3, 117/5, 118/1, 119, 120 — partition/share demarcation for 117/3 specifically must be verified
positive_findings: Target survey 117/3 is explicitly present in the MR entry
No caveat (ವೀರಸ್) recorded on target or adjacent sub-divisions
Clear title chain visible: previous owner ಹುಚ್ಚೇಗೌಡ → current owner ಹೆಚ್ ಸಿ ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ via inheritance (ಪೌತಿ)
Mutation duly approved by Tahsildar on 04/12/2012
Mutation is old (2012) — well beyond the 2-year recent-mutation risk window
reasoning: Target 117/3 found in MR with a clearly documented mutation, satisfying the LOW risk criteria
The ಪೌತಿ (inheritance) mutation shows legitimate succession from deceased ancestor ಚನ್ನೇಗೌಡ to his son ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ and co-heirs
Absence of caveat and possession entries removes the key HIGH risk triggers
However, since multiple heirs (sons + wife ನಂಜಮ್ಮ) jointly inherited, 117/3 is likely co-owned — a partition deed or NOC from all co-owners is essential before purchase
Only one MR entry over 10+ years is unusual; buyer should obtain the full 30-year EC and latest RTC to confirm no intervening transactions
recommendations: Obtain latest RTC (Pahani) for 117/3 to confirm current ownership status and extent
Procure 30-year Encumbrance Certificate (EC) from Sub-Registrar's office
Verify partition deed / family settlement among all legal heirs of ಚನ್ನೇಗೌಡ for Sy. No. 117/3
Obtain registered release deeds or NOCs from all co-heirs (ಲಿಂಗೇಗೌಡ, ಅಪ್ಪಾಜಿಗೌಡ, ರಾಮಕೃಷ್ಣ, ನಿಂಗೇಗೌಡ, ವೆಂಕಟೇಗೌಡ, ರಾಮೇಗೌಡ, ಕೆಂಚೇಗೌಡ, ನಂಜಮ್ಮ)
Conduct physical survey/boundary verification and obtain Tippani, Akarbandh, Podi extract for 117/3
Issue paper publication inviting claims/objections before executing sale
Verify no pending agricultural land ceiling or PTCL Act restrictions
llm_risk.summary: Target survey 117/3 is clearly present in the MR with a valid 2012 inheritance mutation (ಪೌತಿ) from ಚನ್ನೇಗೌಡ to his heirs. No caveat, no possession disputes, and the title chain is visible — placing this in the LOW risk band. The primary concern is joint inheritance by multiple co-heirs, requiring partition/release deeds and a full EC/RTC verification before purchase.
